problem: The decay rate $M$ of muons in a beam traveling at high speed can be modeled by the function $M(t)=2\cdot {e}^{-2t},$ where $t$ is the time, in microseconds, since observations started. What will be the decay rate of the muons after $0.5$ microseconds? Round your answer to three decimal places.

examples.problem:
On a particular day, the rate $E$ at which tourists enter a small country can be modeled as $E(t) = 50\cdot 3^{0.2t}$ tourists per hour, where $t$ is the time, in hours, after midnight. The rate at which tourists leave the country can be modeled as $L(t)=100\cdot 2^{0.2t}$ tourists per hour, where $t$ is also the time in hours after midnight.

What is the rate of change in the number of tourists in the country at $10\text{:}00\,\textrm{am}?$
examples.worked_solution:
The rate of change of the number of tourists in the country at time $t$ is equal to the entry rate minus the exit rate at time $t,$ that is, 

$$
E(t)-L(t).
$$

Since $10\text{:}00\,\textrm{am}$ is ten hours after midnight, we have $t=10.$ Substituting $t=10,$ the rate of change in the number of tourists in the country at $10\text{:}00\,\textrm{am}$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}E(10)-L(10) & =50\cdot {3}^{0.2(10)}-100\cdot {2}^{0.2(10)} \\  & =450-400 \\  & =50.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the rate of change in the number of tourists in the country at $10\text{:}00\,\textrm{am}$ is $50$ tourists per hour.

feedback.problem: The function $S(t)$ gives the area, in squared centimeters, of a thin sheet of ice as it melts $t$ minutes after observations start. What is the best interpretation of ${S}^{′}(5)=-7?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The function ${S}^{′}(t)$ represents the rate at which the area of the sheet is decreasing $t$ minutes after the beginning of the observation.

Therefore, since it is negative, ${S}^{′}(5)=-7$ means:

$\,$ *$5$ minutes after the observations began, the area of the sheet decreases at a rate of $7$ squared centimeters per minute.*

submitted_fields.submitted_value: $5$ minutes after the observations began, the area of the sheet decreases at a rate of $7$ squared centimeters per minute
